$comment: Every stylesheet hash PolicyDocumentRenderer has ever emitted (card S02, Q3 A).
APPEND-ONLY: published /privacy documents are never rewritten or swept, so a
hash stays needed forever. PolicyDocumentRendererTests fails when the renderer's
current StyleHash is missing here; csp-style-policy.test.ts fails when an entry
is missing from the accounts style-src. Values are what a browser computes:
the stylesheet with LF line endings (the HTML parser folds CRLF to LF).
